# Generated by tools/build_heavenly_gates.py.

# Open a Heavenly Gate in a county of a region chosen by its aura.
ac_open_heavenly_gate_effect = {
	random_list = {
		3 = {
			random_county_in_region = {
				region = world_rasen_azuma
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_gate_level } exists = holder }
				set_variable = { name = ac_gate_level value = { 11 15 } months = 3 }
				set_variable = { name = ac_gate_level value = { value = var:ac_gate_level round = yes } months = 3 }
				add_county_modifier = { modifier = ac_heavenly_gate_modifier months = 3 }
				save_scope_as = ac_gate_county
			}
		}
		6 = {
			random_county_in_region = {
				region = world_rasen_inner
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_gate_level } exists = holder }
				set_variable = { name = ac_gate_level value = { 8 12 } months = 3 }
				set_variable = { name = ac_gate_level value = { value = var:ac_gate_level round = yes } months = 3 }
				add_county_modifier = { modifier = ac_heavenly_gate_modifier months = 3 }
				save_scope_as = ac_gate_county
			}
		}
		2 = {
			random_county_in_region = {
				region = world_rasen_outer_north
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_gate_level } exists = holder }
				set_variable = { name = ac_gate_level value = { 6 9 } months = 3 }
				set_variable = { name = ac_gate_level value = { value = var:ac_gate_level round = yes } months = 3 }
				add_county_modifier = { modifier = ac_heavenly_gate_modifier months = 3 }
				save_scope_as = ac_gate_county
			}
		}
		3 = {
			random_county_in_region = {
				region = world_rasen_outer
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_gate_level } exists = holder }
				set_variable = { name = ac_gate_level value = { 5 8 } months = 3 }
				set_variable = { name = ac_gate_level value = { value = var:ac_gate_level round = yes } months = 3 }
				add_county_modifier = { modifier = ac_heavenly_gate_modifier months = 3 }
				save_scope_as = ac_gate_county
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:ac_gate_county }
		# Players nearby sense it.
		every_player = {
			limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator capital_county ?= { ac_same_gate_region_trigger = yes } }
			trigger_event = ac_gate.0001
		}
		# Unclaimed, the local sects take it.
		scope:ac_gate_county.holder = { add_to_variable_list = { name = ac_gate_claims target = scope:ac_gate_county } trigger_event = { id = ac_gate.0010 days = 45 } }
	}
}

# Character scope, scope:ac_gate_county, var:ac_gate_successes set: absorb a share.
ac_gate_absorb_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_gate_gain value = ac_gate_share_value }
	ac_gain_aura_pressure_effect = { AP = scope:ac_gate_gain }
	ac_add_core_progress_effect = { CORE = soul PROGRESS = 20 }
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = ac_gate_touched_modifier years = 2 }
	remove_variable = ac_gate_successes
	remove_variable = ac_gate_won_contest
}

# Character scope: roll Athletics or Insight successes (5-6 on a d6, sixes explode).
ac_gate_roll_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = ac_gate_successes value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = ac_gate_dice_left value = ac_gate_dice }
	while = {
		limit = { var:ac_gate_dice_left > 0 }
		random_list = {
			4 = { }
			1 = { change_variable = { name = ac_gate_successes add = 1 } }
			1 = { change_variable = { name = ac_gate_successes add = 2 } }
		}
		change_variable = { name = ac_gate_dice_left add = -1 }
	}
	remove_variable = ac_gate_dice_left
}

# Character scope, scope:ac_gate_county: the Gate is spent.
ac_gate_drain_effect = {
	scope:ac_gate_county = { remove_variable = ac_gate_level remove_county_modifier = ac_heavenly_gate_modifier }
}

# Character scope: draw the whole Gate into a Transformation (the IF's awakening).
ac_gate_awaken_effect = {
	random_list = {
		0 = { modifier = { add = ac_gate_awaken_chance } trigger_event = ac_gate.0021 }
		0 = { modifier = { add = { value = 100 subtract = ac_gate_awaken_chance } } increase_wounds_no_death_effect = { REASON = fight } custom_tooltip = ac_gate_awaken_failed_tt }
	}
}

# Place the Spirit Fruit Groves.
ac_place_spirit_groves_effect = {
	while = {
		count = 3
		random_county_in_region = {
			region = world_rasen_azuma
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_spirit_grove } title_province = { has_special_building_slot = no } }
			set_variable = ac_spirit_grove
			title_province = { add_special_building_slot = ac_spirit_fruit_grove add_special_building = ac_spirit_fruit_grove }
		}
	}
	while = {
		count = 8
		random_county_in_region = {
			region = world_rasen_inner
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_spirit_grove } title_province = { has_special_building_slot = no } }
			set_variable = ac_spirit_grove
			title_province = { add_special_building_slot = ac_spirit_fruit_grove add_special_building = ac_spirit_fruit_grove }
		}
	}
	while = {
		count = 2
		random_county_in_region = {
			region = world_rasen_outer_north
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_spirit_grove } title_province = { has_special_building_slot = no } }
			set_variable = ac_spirit_grove
			title_province = { add_special_building_slot = ac_spirit_fruit_grove add_special_building = ac_spirit_fruit_grove }
		}
	}
	while = {
		count = 4
		random_county_in_region = {
			region = world_rasen_outer
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_spirit_grove } title_province = { has_special_building_slot = no } }
			set_variable = ac_spirit_grove
			title_province = { add_special_building_slot = ac_spirit_fruit_grove add_special_building = ac_spirit_fruit_grove }
		}
	}
}

# Character scope (a county holder): harvest every grove held.
ac_harvest_spirit_fruit_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_spirit_fruit } } set_variable = { name = ac_spirit_fruit value = 0 } }
	every_held_county = {
		limit = { has_variable = ac_spirit_grove }
		prev = { change_variable = { name = ac_spirit_fruit add = 2 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { ac_spirit_fruit_count > 10 } set_variable = { name = ac_spirit_fruit value = 10 } }
}

# Character scope: eat a spirit fruit.
ac_eat_spirit_fruit_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_fruit_gain value = ac_spirit_fruit_gain }
	ac_gain_aura_pressure_effect = { AP = scope:ac_fruit_gain }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_fruit_eaten } change_variable = { name = ac_fruit_eaten add = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = ac_fruit_eaten value = 1 years = 1 } }
}

# AI holders eat their fruit and serve it to their court's cultivators.
ac_ai_spirit_fruit_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes ac_spirit_fruit_count > 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator } ac_eat_spirit_fruit_effect = yes change_variable = { name = ac_spirit_fruit add = -1 } }
		every_courtier = {
			limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator prev.var:ac_spirit_fruit > 0 }
			ac_eat_spirit_fruit_effect = yes
			prev = { change_variable = { name = ac_spirit_fruit add = -1 } }
		}
	}
}
